chunks: The day when friend will help no friend in the least, nor will they be helped,
ai.seo_question: What happens to friendships and alliances on the Day of Judgment according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the futility of worldly patronage (wilayah) and social hierarchies on the Day of Judgment, where only divine merit matters. It serves as a profound reminder that neither tribal loyalty nor political alliances can secure salvation, emphasizing individual accountability before Allah.
